initiative.title: Srcly UX review follow-through
initiative.summary: Preserve source-backed investigation while fixing trust defects and separating analysis scope, revision identity, and provenance.
initiative.next_action: Review the two independent proof-sized shapes. Start with complete Changes inventory and retain the separate trace explanation proof. No broader implementation approval is recorded.

sources.location: November 22 maintainer follow-through request (private; not embedded)
sources.anchor: Separate focused bugs from projects that need shaping; land initial intent.

sources.location: November 22 Srcly UX evaluation package (private; repository-safe synthesis in study-crosswalk.md)

claims.statement: Land initial intent and independently verified bug fixes; shape larger projects before implementation.
Make source identity and evidence limits visible. Preserve unknowns rather than implying false certainty.
Withhold receipt-based provenance, general behavioral comparison and persistent question workspaces from the initial implementation slice.

shape.appetite: Two narrow first slices, each with an exact before/after proof.
shape.problem: Srcly can silently omit changed paths or make context look like exact field ancestry.

recommended_shape.primary: Complete the Git-backed Changes footprint and preserve exact revision identity through source and Back.
recommended_shape.independent: Project a compact field evidence summary in the existing trace inspector.

success_moves: Show all 15 changed paths and honest metric gaps on the historical fixture.
Open the exact added model row at its head revision and return to the same selection.
Keep Touched and Net distinct for a metadata-only edit reverted within the range.
Distinguish actual title carriage from incidental tags and keep trace limits visible.

first_proof.question: Can the tool expose the complete change footprint and explain a focused field trace without losing source identity or inventing evidence?
first_proof.artifact: Two tiny fixture walkthroughs with an expected/actual table and same-revision source witnesses.
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed only when all paths, revision selection, Touched/Net and both title/tags positive and negative controls hold.

rabbit_holes: Unify Changes and Compare into a new workspace
Treat subscriptions as the same as value provenance
Infer agent attribution or collect receipts in either slice.

history.note: Summarized the UX review and mapped findings to independent issues or small PR lanes without pre-approving the candidate shapes.
Captured proposed first proofs for #444 and #442. The remaining product choices stay separate and this does not approve broad implementation.
